summary: Carlos Mota Pinto (1936–1985) was a jurist and a professor of law who was prime minister from November 1978 until the summer of 1979, at the head of the second of the governments the President named in those years. He is in the atlas as a head of government of the period between the first constitutional governments and the election of 1979.
